{{Top|leg}}
The '''PS-9 burst tracker''' was a tracking device in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Once attached to a target, it would transmit its location via a burst transmission once the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] left [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Ando">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>
